inputs.text: DHS is using this arrest to turn a single case into a warning campaign against New York City’s sanctuary policies. The agency’s version paints the city as recklessly endangering the public, but that framing also serves federal interests: stoking fear and making stronger immigration enforcement look inevitable. The clash may be less about public safety than about who gets to control the narrative—and the people caught in it.
